title: Philippians 1:6 (ESV):
paragraphs:
Philippians 1:6 (ESV):
“And I am sure of this, that He who began a good work in you will bring it to completion at the day of Jesus Christ.”

Sometimes you don’t feel it.
Sometimes you can’t see the progress.
But God is still working on you.
Hindi ka tapos. Hindi ka failure.
You are under construction by the hands of a perfect God.
Keep going.
